races.paceDynamic: Four confirmed front-runners (Treanmor, Pilu, Ironwill, Albaydaa) will create a fierce early battle over this sprint trip at Newmarket. The strong early pace will stretch the field significantly, with prominent racers Song Of The Clyde, Silent Applause, and Boston Dan trying to track the leaders. This setup creates a stamina test despite the 6f distance, as the sustained gallop will expose any horse lacking finishing speed. The race shape clearly favors hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks who can capitalize on the expected pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders engage in a genuine speed battle through halfway
scenarios.body: The leaders will tie up badly in the final furlong, creating perfect stalking conditions for closers with tactical speed. Hold-up specialists will have ideal positioning to strike late when the pace crumbles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can sit just off the fierce early pace
scenarios.body: The tracking horse will have the perfect trip to strike when the leaders weaken, avoiding both the early speed battle and getting too far back. This scenario suits horses with tactical pace who can quicken decisively.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Treanmor or Pilu can steal a march and dictate more controlled fractions
scenarios.body: The early leader will have enough left to hold off late challenges, particularly with the benefit of racing on the favorable rail position. Recent winners often have the confidence to sustain their effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners surprisingly settle and avoid early engagement
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with less pace collapse, allowing more horses to remain competitive in the finish. This unpredictable scenario opens up the race to a wider range of running styles.

watchPoints.text: Treanmor and Pilu could set suicidal fractions if they engage early, creating perfect conditions for closers

Sovereign Spell faces quick turnaround after winning 17 days ago which could impact recovery and performance

races.paceDynamic: Aspect Island gets an uncontested lead with minimal pressure from the sole front-runner position. Six horses (My Mate Alfie, Time For Sandals, Quinault, Washington Heights, Crestofdistinction, Beckford's Folly, Prince Of India) will create a scrum for prominent positions, causing traffic problems and interfering with each other's runs from 2-3 furlongs out. The large hold-up contingent (Diligent Harry, Elmonjed, Jasour, Aramram, Run To Freedom, Completely Random) will face a wall of horses to navigate in the straight. This congested pace dynamic heavily favours front-runners and those who can secure clean early positions without getting caught in the prominent pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Aspect Island maintains sustainable fractions without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The 3-year-old gets ideal splits while the prominent pack battles behind, creating perfect conditions for the leader to kick clear. Late closers face too much traffic as the prominent group fans across the track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Aspect Island from halfway
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and sets up perfectly for the strongest closer with the best draw. Diligent Harry or Elmonjed can unleash finishing kicks over tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates multiple hard-luck stories in running
scenarios.body: A less fancied hold-up horse with room to maneuver capitalizes while better horses get shuffled back. The pace collapses late as the prominent pack stops quickly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Washington Heights or Quinault challenge Aspect Island from the gates
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable, killing off the front division entirely. Strong closers with proven finishing kicks sweep past the collapsed leaders.

races.paceDynamic: Hawk Mountain and Venetian Prince will contest the early lead, with Hawk Mountain likely to dictate given his superior class and Ryan Moore's tactical awareness. The honest gallop will be maintained by prominent runners Avicenna, Hankelow, Oxagon and Commander's Intent settling just behind the pace. Hidden Force faces the toughest task from his hold-up style, needing the front-runners to collapse late over this testing mile at Newmarket. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If Hawk Mountain and Venetian Prince establish a solid but not destructive early pace.
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows the classier prominent runners to travel smoothly before asserting in the final two furlongs. Hawk Mountain's superior rating and recent form make him hard to peg back despite carrying the pace duties.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Speed Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Hawk Mountain and Venetian Prince go too fast early in a genuine speed battle.
scenarios.body: The pace collapse opens the door for those settling just behind to sweep past the weakening leaders. Hankelow and Avicenna are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their prominent styles and strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Front-Running Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Hawk Mountain gets an uncontested lead with Venetian Prince settling behind him.
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle runner controls the race from the front and has enough class to resist all challengers in the straight. Ryan Moore's tactical nous proves decisive as the field struggles to reel him in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and Hidden Force gets the perfect setup for his hold-up style.
scenarios.body: Hidden Force times his challenge perfectly as the prominent runners tie up, with William Buick delivering him with a perfectly timed finish. His recent Newmarket wins give him the tactical edge despite the unfavorable race shape.

races.paceDynamic: Maho Bay and Guildmaster will ensure a strong early gallop from the front, with both having proven leadership qualities from their winning debuts. Amadeus Mozart and Sir Griflet will sit prominently behind the leaders, while Birgham Dub is the sole hold-up performer in a small field. The sustained pace set by two willing front-runners over this 1m2f trip will create a searching test of stamina. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can dictate terms, as the hold-up horse Birgham Dub faces a significant tactical disadvantage with limited cover in such a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate completely
scenarios.trigger: If Maho Bay and Guildmaster maintain strong gallop throughout without faltering
scenarios.body: The relentless pace plays to their strengths while stretching the field behind them. Both have winning experience and the class to sustain their effort over this demanding trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes late
scenarios.trigger: If Amadeus Mozart or Sir Griflet get perfect positioning behind the leaders
scenarios.body: They benefit from the strong pace while conserving energy for a decisive move in the final two furlongs. The front-runners' honest gallop sets up the race perfectly for these tactical types.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold up horse overcomes odds
scenarios.trigger: If Birgham Dub finds enough cover despite small field size
scenarios.body: The sustained pace plays into the hold-up style while Ryan's tactical skills maximize limited opportunities. However, the lack of pace angles in a six-runner field makes this challenging.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Galiyan springs major surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Galiyan possesses hidden class to match his high rating
scenarios.body: Murphy's booking and Balding's confidence suggest untapped ability that could shock more exposed rivals. The strong pace would suit if he has the tactical speed to position well.

races.paceDynamic: Goldmoyne is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the rail, likely setting a steady tempo without pressure through the early stages. The large field of 18 runners creates positioning challenges, with prominent runners like Percy's Lad, Dragon Leader, and Morte Point needing to secure good early spots behind Goldmoyne. The abundance of hold-up horses including Jordan Electrics, Storm Free, Royal Velvet, and Jumby will create significant traffic issues in a bunched finish over 7f at Newmarket. This tactical setup strongly favors prominent racers who can secure good positions and avoid the inevitable scrimmaging that will hamper the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners secure ideal positions behind Goldmoyne's steady pace
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows horses like Percy's Lad, Dragon Leader, and Morte Point to travel smoothly and kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Traffic problems behind severely compromise the chances of the numerous hold-up specialists.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Goldmoyne maintains his recent winning form and the lack of early pace pressure suits his stamina
scenarios.body: The steady gallop plays perfectly into Goldmoyne's hands as he builds an unassailable lead, with Storm Free and Huscal best placed among the closers to pick up the pieces. The hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners fail to capitalize and gaps appear for the hold-up horses in the straight
scenarios.body: Royal Velvet and Jordan Electrics benefit from their class and William Buick's positioning skills, getting the right runs at the right time. The pace becomes truly run to suit as Goldmoyne tires.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Goldmoyne goes too fast early or gets pressured by the prominent runners unexpectedly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from halfway with horses like Eminency and Crimson Spirit able to use their tactical speed. This unlikely scenario requires significant early pace, which the field composition doesn't suggest.

watchPoints.text: Goldmoyne gets an uncontested lead and the prominent runners fail to apply pressure early enough to prevent him building a winning margin
Percy's Lad and Dragon Leader clash for position behind Goldmoyne, compromising both their chances and opening the door for Morte Point
Traffic problems in the straight severely hamper Royal Velvet and Storm Free despite their class advantages
Bold Impact's reliability after pulling up last time, any market confidence would be significant
The draw impact with 18 runners, particularly how the hold-up horses positioned wide can secure racing room
